lineage.section_title: Expanded Timeline of Stacked Invariants (Deeper Prehistory to Mid-20th Century Foundational Close)
lineage.text: Controlled fire (combustion): Opportunistic use ~1M+ years ago (Homo erectus evidence); deliberate fire-making ~400,000 years ago (Neanderthal sites, e.g., East Farm/Barnham, England – flint + pyrite sparks, heat-altered sediments/handaxes, repeated hearths). Widespread controlled use ~8000+ BC. **Utility:** Cooking (increased nutrient bioavailability), heating, material transformation (pottery, bricks) — foundational controlled chemical reaction.
